confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Sydney price levels, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by suburb, season and event demand. The FX observation comes from search-result summaries, not a direct read of the RBA page, and the 15 October figure is the most recent RBA value cited there. Values are USD at an approximate AUD conversion, with no tier or AUD-based calculation returned.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Sydney's own price level, cross-checked against other large Australian capitals (Melbourne, Brisbane) for restaurant and accommodation tiers. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer price because direct knowledge of bar prices is weaker.
